app.name.description: The product name, shown beside the logo.

connection.connected.description: The interface reached the session host.

connection.connecting.description: The interface is reaching the session host.

connection.reconnecting.description: The connection to the session host ended, and the interface is reaching it again.

connection.unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo could not start its session host
connection.unavailable.description: The shell could not find or start the session host.

conversation.activity.starting.description: The working line while the core creates the workspace for work just sent.

conversation.activity.thinking.description: The working line while the agent works between replies and tools.

conversation.activity.writing.description: The working line while the agent streams a reply.

conversation.jumpToLatest.description: Returns the conversation to its newest messages.

conversation.reply.failed.defaultMessage: The reply did not reach the agent ({code}). It is back in the input.
conversation.reply.failed.description: A reply failed; {code} is the protocol code.

conversation.reply.label.description: The accessible label of the reply input.

conversation.reply.placeholder.defaultMessage: Reply or give a new instruction

conversation.reply.send.description: Accessible name of the button that sends a reply.

conversation.reply.starting.defaultMessage: The agent starts in a moment
conversation.reply.starting.description: The reply card placeholder while the agent of work just sent has not started.

conversation.tool.running.description: A tool call that has not finished.

conversation.tool.succeeded.description: A finished tool call; the count shows when the agent called the tool more than once.

conversation.unavailable.description: The session could not attach or start; the code names why.

keyboard.command.description: A shortcut with the command modifier: Command on macOS, Control elsewhere. {key} is the key.

notice.conversation_item_invalid.defaultMessage: A message from the agent could not be shown.
notice.conversation_item_invalid.description: The adapter produced an item outside the protocol's limits.

notice.core_decoding_failed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not read part of the agent's output.
notice.core_decoding_failed.description: The provider adapter could not decode a chunk.

notice.core_link_unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo could not read the agent's output for a moment. The agent keeps working.
notice.core_link_unavailable.description: The resident Lervo process was unreachable while decoding.

notice.provider_turn_failed.defaultMessage: The agent's turn ended without finishing ({subtype}).
notice.provider_turn_failed.description: Claude Code's result did not succeed.

notice.unknown.description: A Lervo notice without a catalog message.

notifications.finished.description: A desktop notification: the agent finished its turn.

notifications.needsYou.description: A desktop notification: the agent asked the user something.

start.error.application_unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo is not reachable on this computer.
start.error.application_unavailable.description: The resident Lervo process is not running.

start.error.conversation_mode_unsupporte.defaultMessage: This agent cannot run here yet.
start.error.conversation_mode_unsupporte.description: The core refused the conversation mode for the chosen agent.

start.error.other.defaultMessage: Lervo could not start the work ({code}).
start.error.other.description: A start failure without its own message; {code} is the protocol code.

start.error.provider_cli_unavailable.defaultMessage: The agent's CLI was not found on this computer.

start.error.session_host_unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo is not connected to this computer.
start.error.session_host_unavailable.description: The interface is not connected to the session host.

start.error.workspace_start_failed.defaultMessage: Lervo could not create the workspace{stage, select, none {} other { at the {stage} stage}}.
start.error.workspace_start_failed.description: The core could not create the workspace; {stage} is the core stage that failed, or none.

start.explain.defaultMessage: Lervo opens a workspace and its workstream for this, then starts {provider} there. You follow and steer it in the conversation.
start.explain.description: What starting work does, under the instruction input. {provider} is the chosen agent.

start.instruction.label.description: The accessible label of the instruction input.

start.instruction.placeholder.defaultMessage: Describe the work, as you would to a colleague
start.instruction.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the instruction input on the start screen.

start.provider.codex.description: The Codex agent in the agent chooser.

start.provider.label.description: The accessible label of the provider choice.

start.repository.label.description: The accessible label of the repository choice.

start.repository.none.defaultMessage: Register a repository with lervo repository register to start work.
start.repository.none.description: Shown when the host has no registered repository.

start.submit.description: Accessible name of the button that starts work.

terminal.failed.description: A terminal request failed; {code} is the protocol code.

workspace.mode.cli.description: Switches the workspace to the CLI conversation.

workspace.mode.failed.description: Switching the conversation mode failed; {code} is the protocol code.

workspace.mode.label.description: Accessible name of the conversation mode switch.

workspace.mode.native.description: Switches the workspace to the native conversation.

workspaces.label.description: Accessible name of the workspace list.

workspaces.new.description: The row that opens the start screen.

workspaces.new.key.description: The key that, with the command modifier, opens the start screen.

workspaces.status.needsYou.description: Status text for assistive technology: the workspace needs the user.

workspaces.status.working.description: Status text for assistive technology: the agent is working.

workspaces.unavailable.defaultMessage: Lervo could not load the workspaces ({code}). It tries again on the next connection.
workspaces.unavailable.description: The workspace list could not reload; {code} is the protocol code.
